title: PipelineCorridorCurrent
description: Customer operator -> orchestrator, published on <root>/corridor/<customer_id>/<corridor_id>/current, QoS 0, every 2s. The PIPELINE_AC service profile's closed-loop signal (06-service-profiles-and-power-quality.md): the AC current induced on the pipe by nearby transmission, versus the customer's mitigation limit, that the orchestrator's PIPELINE_AC controller holds below limit_a.

i_ac_a.description: Induced AC current measured on the pipe (test-lead/coupon reading).

limit_a.description: The customer's mitigation limit (e.g. NACE SP0177 15 A rms guidance) for this corridor.
